speaker: Penny
text: Huh. This is really delicious, isn't it? Still can't talk to me unless you're drunk, huh? Oh, sweetie, you are so damaged.

speaker: Leonard
text: It's like looking into an obnoxious little mirror, isn't it? Something you'd like to share? A tale of the woo, perhaps?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Fifteen years old. Dennis Kimmy is fifteen years old, and he's already correcting my work. Today I went from being Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart to, you know, that other guy. Oh, God, now even you're smarter than me.

speaker: Howard
text: Hey, I'm damaged too. How about a hug for Howie? Antonio Salieri. You know, Sheldon, you don't have so many friends that you can afford to start insulting them. Just eat, Sheldon, you'll feel better.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Why waste food? In Texas, when a cow goes dry, they don't keep feeding it, they just take her out and shoot her between the eyes.

speaker: Penny
text: I'm confused. Did Sheldon stop giving milk?

speaker: Leonard
text: Can't let this kid get to you. You always knew that someday someone would come along who was younger and smarter.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Yes, but I assumed I would have been dead hundreds of years, and that there'd be an asterisk by his name because he'd be a cyborg.

speaker: Penny
text: So you got a little competition. I really don't see what the big deal is.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Well, of course you don't. You've never excelled at anything.

speaker: Penny
text: I don't understand exactly. How did he get any friends in the first place?

speaker: Leonard
text: What are you gonna do, Sheldon? Just give up?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Yes. That's what a rational person does when his entire life's work is invalidated by a post-pubescent Asian wunderkind. He ceases his fruitless efforts, he donates his body to scientific research, and he waits to die.
